DARK FAR FRONT remains grounded ahead/LEFT of shoulder. Both hind paws support, near hind behind/right of hip and far hind ahead/left. Three planted paws and one raised near forepaw.
This is a gentle four-beat walking cycle. Accurate paws/wrist/elbow/hock anatomy, exactly FOUR attached legs, no floating whole body, no duplicated paws, no detached feet, no rubber deformation. Far limbs naturally darker and partly occluded but retain a complete anatomical silhouette. Head, torso and tail form same character in same camera across drawings; only leg articulation and restrained weight shift change.
No mane, no cub, no scenery/background/brown halo, no ground/cast shadow, no grid/colored skeleton/words/numbers.
